user.title: Add Fujitsu air conditioner
user.description: Create a climate entity for a Fujitsu General air conditioner that uses the ARRAH2E IR protocol (AR-RAH2E, AR-RY, AR-RCE1E and similar remotes), sent through a Home Assistant infrared emitter.

data_description.emitter_entity_id: The infrared emitter entity that faces the indoor unit (Broadlink, ESPHome and other infrared integrations).
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Shown as the room's current temperature.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Shown as the room's current humidity.

error.invalid_emitter: Select an available infrared emitter entity.

abort.already_configured: This air conditioner is already configured.
abort.no_emitters: No native infrared emitter entities were found.
